request.question:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.

events.thought: I count public symbols in the symbol profile table, scoping to the kumo package and excluding test files. Three rules from the evidence are implemented literally on the name column: a symbol is public only if its own name does not start with an underscore (LEFT(name,1) <> '_'), dunder names are excluded (is_dunder not true), and for methods the enclosing class name must also not start with an underscore (self-join through enclosing_class_symbol_id). Nested symbols are removed by requiring the qualified name to contain no '<locals>' segment and, for classes/functions, no dot (i.e. the qualified name equals the plain top-level name); methods are allowed one scope level but still must not contain '<locals>'. Kind is limited to class, function and method, with is_public = true and in_test_file = false. Assumptions: (1) time window — none, the question has no period; (2) missing/zero values — all three kinds are returned as rows via a fixed list of kinds left-joined to the counts, with COALESCE(...,0) so a kind with no qualifying symbol reports 0 rather than disappearing, because the request says one row per kind; division does not apply; (3) package boundary — the package is matched as module equal to 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo' or prefixed by that path plus a dot, because a bare prefix like would also match sibling packages; tests are excluded both by the test-file flag and by the '.tests' module prefix; (4) ties — not applicable, there is no ranking.

It also excludes nested functions/classes using `<locals>` and qualified-name dot checks. events.sql: WITH kinds AS (SELECT 'class' AS kind, 1 AS ord UNION ALL SELECT 'function', 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'method', 3), pub AS (SELECT sp.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS sp LEFT JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile AS cls ON sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = cls.symbol_id WHERE sp.in_test_file = FALSE AND (sp.module = 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo' OR sp.module LIKE 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo.%') AND sp.module NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology.retrieval.kumo.tests%' AND sp.is_public = TRUE AND COALESCE(sp.is_dunder, FALSE) = FALSE AND LEFT(sp.name, 1) <> '_' AND sp.kind IN ('class', 'function', 'method') AND sp.qualname NOT LIKE '%<locals>%' AND (sp.kind = 'method' OR sp.qualname NOT LIKE '%.%') AND (sp.kind <> 'method' OR (cls.name IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(cls.name, 1) <> '_')) GROUP BY sp.kind) SELECT k.kind AS kind, COALESCE(p.public_count, 0) AS public_count FROM kinds AS k LEFT JOIN pub AS p ON k.kind = p.kind ORDER BY k.ord;

answer.response: This counts how many public classes, module-level functions and methods exist in the kumo package while ignoring anything under its tests folder. Each symbol's own name must not begin with an underscore, double-underscore special names are dropped, and for methods the surrounding class name must also not begin with an underscore, using the symbol profile's name, kind, module, test-file flag and enclosing-class link. Results are grouped by kind and reported in the order class, function, method, with any kind that has no qualifying symbols shown as a zero count.

gold_sql: SELECT s.kind, COUNT(*) AS public_count FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND NOT f.is_test AND s.is_public GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
